summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting an extraordinary board meeting on July 22, 2026, where the Board of Directors approved the dismissal of Director Marcelo Gasparino da Silva for leaking confidential information from a June 19, 2026 board meeting. The decision, based on an independent investigation, follows the company's Misconduct Management Policy and will be submitted to shareholders for ratification. Director Silva was also removed from board committees. This is an abrupt board-level removal triggered by misconduct, constituting a special situation management change. No financial terms are disclosed; watch for the shareholder meeting outcome and potential governance fallout.
